name: Yanxin Huang
affiliation: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
school: School of Information and Communication Engineering
bio: My research focuses on medical image analysis and geometry-guided learning for radiotherapy target delineation. I study how sparse contour prompts and anatomical context can support three-dimensional target completion.
bio_zh: 我的研究关注医学图像分析与放疗靶区勾画，探索如何结合稀疏轮廓提示、解剖信息与几何先验，完成三维临床靶区重建。

paper.title: CTV-DGG: Prompt-Conditioned Three-Dimensional Clinical Target Volume Delineation with Geometric Guidance
